label: General
tooltip: What Illegal Mode does: FATEs, Critical Encounters, pots, combat, treasure, waiting times, repairs and what happens when you die.

prefer_pot_fates.label: Prefer pot FATEs
prefer_pot_fates.tooltip: Puts Magic Pot FATEs first, ahead of Critical Encounters and other FATEs. While this is on, pots can't be turned off on the FATEs page.

should_farm_pot_chests.label: Farm pot chests after pot FATEs
should_farm_pot_chests.tooltip: After a pot FATE, drink the Magical Elixir and follow the compass to the chests for as long as the buff lasts. If the compass shows nothing, BOCCHI checks the known chest spots instead.

should_preposition_to_pots.label: Wait near pots before they spawn
should_preposition_to_pots.tooltip: Go to the next pot early and wait there. How early is set on the Pot timing page.

leave_fate_travel_for_ce_seconds.label: Switch to a CE when it has this many seconds left
leave_fate_travel_for_ce_seconds.tooltip:
While walking to a FATE, BOCCHI turns around for a Critical Encounter once its registration has this many seconds left or fewer. A higher number means it leaves sooner. 0 = switch as soon as a CE appears.
A FATE you already started is finished first, unless Leave mid-FATE for a CE is on.

leave_engaged_fate_for_critical_encounte.label: Leave mid-FATE for a CE
leave_engaged_fate_for_critical_encounte.tooltip: Also leaves a FATE you are fighting in when a Critical Encounter's registration is about to close (same seconds as above). Pot FATEs are never left while Prefer pot FATEs is on.

combat_autorotation.label: Combat rotation
combat_autorotation.tooltip:
The plugin that fights for you in FATEs, Critical Encounters and Mob Farmer. It is switched off while you travel.
None: you fight yourself.

disabled_wrath_occult_options.label: Phantom job actions Wrath Combo may use
disabled_wrath_occult_options.tooltip:
Uncheck an action to stop Wrath Combo from using it while BOCCHI is running. For example Berserker's Rage, which can get you hit by mechanics.
Changes apply the next time you start Illegal Mode or Mob Farmer.
Hover an action to see what it is called in Wrath Combo.
disabled_wrath_occult_options.empty: Wrath Combo isn't running, or this version of it has no phantom job options.
disabled_wrath_occult_options.built_in: BOCCHI always keeps this one off.

update_boss_mod_presets_automatically.label: Update presets automatically
update_boss_mod_presets_automatically.tooltip: BOCCHI rewrites its BossMod presets whenever you change the settings below, start Illegal Mode or change job. To apply the settings below only when you choose, untick this and press Update presets.
update_boss_mod_presets_automatically.button_tooltip: Rebuild BOCCHI's BossMod presets from the settings below. Changes you made to those presets in BossMod are lost.
update_boss_mod_presets_automatically.button_tooltip_auto_on: Not needed while Update presets automatically is on.

max_distance_by_role.label: Set max distance to target based on role
max_distance_by_role.tooltip: Gives melee jobs and ranged jobs each their own distance to the target.

melee_on_hitbox.label: Melee stay on hitbox
melee_on_hitbox.tooltip:
Melee jobs stand at the edge of the enemy's hitbox instead of using the melee distance below.
Sage always stays at 5 yalms and Dancer at 10.

max_distance_melee.label: Max distance to target | Melee
max_distance_melee.tooltip: Ignored while Melee stay on hitbox is on.

overdodge.label: Extra dodge space
overdodge.tooltip: How much extra space to keep from AoEs.

delay.label: Delay movement
delay.tooltip: How long the combat AI waits before it moves. Keep this short or you will get hit.

separate_dodge_delay.label: Separate dodge delay
separate_dodge_delay.tooltip: Uses Dodge delay movement for AoE dodges instead of Delay movement.

dodge_delay.label: Dodge delay movement
dodge_delay.tooltip: Only used when Separate dodge delay is on.

stay_mounted_while_waiting_for_ce.label: Stay mounted while waiting for CEs / Forked Tower
stay_mounted_while_waiting_for_ce.tooltip: Stay on your mount while waiting for a Critical Encounter or for Forked Tower to start.

stop_after_return.label: Stop after return and teleport
stop_after_return.tooltip:
Semi-automatic: BOCCHI only gets you close to the next FATE or CE (Return and aethernet), then stops so you walk and fight yourself. If walking is quickest, it stops right away. Start Illegal Mode again for the next one.
Leave it unticked for full automation, including the fighting.

phantom_jobs_leveling_mode.label: Level phantom jobs automatically
phantom_jobs_leveling_mode.tooltip: When your phantom job reaches max level, switch to the next one you've unlocked that isn't maxed yet. Freelancer is skipped.

enable_triage_mode.label: Triage Mode
enable_triage_mode.tooltip: After a FATE or CE, raise dead players nearby with the phantom job below, then carry on. Players who already have a raise are skipped.

should_cast_treasure_sight.label: Cast Treasure Sight at camp
should_cast_treasure_sight.tooltip: Cast Treasure Sight at camp every so often to see how many coffers are left. The interval is set below.
should_cast_treasure_sight.tooltip_disabled: Not needed while Auto treasure hunt is on: it already casts Treasure Sight.

treasure_sight_recast_interval_seconds.label: Seconds between Treasure Sight casts
treasure_sight_recast_interval_seconds.tooltip: How often Treasure Sight is used while waiting at camp.

max_remote_idle_time_seconds.label: Max wait before Return (seconds)
max_remote_idle_time_seconds.tooltip: After a FATE or CE, BOCCHI waits a random time between 2 seconds and this before it uses Return.

max_base_teleport_delay_seconds.label: Max wait before leaving camp (seconds)
max_base_teleport_delay_seconds.tooltip: At camp, BOCCHI waits a random time up to this before it leaves for a FATE or CE. 0 = leave right away.

auto_repair_method.label: Repair method
auto_repair_method.tooltip:
Self-repair: repair your own gear. Needs crafter levels and dark matter.
Mender: use the mender at base camp. If none is found, BOCCHI repairs itself.
Prefer mender: use the mender when one is close, otherwise repair yourself.
If a repair fails, BOCCHI skips it for a while and carries on.

enable_automatic_treasure_hunt_during_il.label: Auto treasure hunt in Illegal Mode
enable_automatic_treasure_hunt_during_il.tooltip:
When there is no FATE or CE to do, BOCCHI returns to camp, uses Treasure Sight and goes on a treasure hunt if enough coffers are left. How many is enough is set on the Treasure Hunter page.
Without Treasure Sight it checks every known coffer spot instead, and always stops for FATEs and CEs.

pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_fate.label: Pause auto treasure hunt for FATEs
pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_fate.tooltip: When a FATE appears, pauses the hunt, does the FATE, then continues the hunt. Without Treasure Sight the hunt always pauses.

pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_pots.label: Pause auto treasure hunt for pots
pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_pots.tooltip:
Pauses the hunt when it is time to leave for the next pot, or a pot is already up, then continues afterwards. Otherwise the hunt keeps going until the pot FATE actually starts.
Needs Farm pot chests or Wait near pots to be on.

pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_critical_en.label: Pause auto treasure hunt for CEs
pause_auto_treasure_hunt_for_critical_en.tooltip: When a Critical Encounter appears, pauses the hunt, does the CE, then continues the hunt. If you are in a fight, BOCCHI finishes it first. Without Treasure Sight the hunt always pauses.

auto_accept_raise.label: Accept raises
auto_accept_raise.tooltip:
Accept a raise as soon as someone gives you one. Works anywhere in Occult Crescent except Forked Tower, also in FATEs and Critical Encounters and when Illegal Mode is off.
YesAlready is paused while you are dead, so it cannot answer the prompt first.

return_to_base_camp_after_death.label: Return to camp if not raised
return_to_base_camp_after_death.tooltip:
If nobody raises you in time, go back to base camp. Never happens inside Forked Tower. If you die in a FATE or Critical Encounter, it waits until that is over, so you keep your reward.
YesAlready is paused while you are dead, so it cannot answer the prompt first.

return_after_death_delay_seconds.label: Wait before returning (seconds)
return_after_death_delay_seconds.tooltip: How long to wait for a raise before going back to base camp. After dying in a FATE or Critical Encounter, the wait starts once it is over.

triage_delay_seconds.label: Wait before raising (seconds)
triage_delay_seconds.tooltip: How long to wait after a FATE or CE before raising, so healers nearby get a chance first. 0 = raise right away.
